answer.rationale: P99 write latency is 5x target and confined to primary region during peak settlement traffic. Rollback is blocked by mandatory security patch. Regional failover (memory_b2) successfully restored latency during March degradation with clean traffic shift and minutes-level recovery. This preserves the security patch, protects customer writes during peak load, and has documented precedent in this infrastructure. Read replica routing (memory_b5) addresses read load but does not solve write path degradation. Capacity addition is slower and circuit breakers contain rather than resolve the latency issue.
